name: find_meeting_times
title: Find free meeting times
description:
The free times and the booking rules for a conversation's customer, from `from` for `days`
days, in the workspace's timezone. With `meeting_id` (from `list_meetings`) they are the
times that meeting could move to. A day outside the booking rules says why in
`outside_rules`: `book_meeting` takes its times only with `outside_rules_ok`, after the
person agrees. Nothing is booked.

meeting_id.description: The times this meeting could move to.
